results.name: FREE DOWNLOAD: Sexy woman in bodysuit posing 233
results.description:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras.

This is a true human size and detailed model of a sporty beautiful young woman of African appearance in sexy bodysuit. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching for variety of architectural visualizations, e.g. beach, swimming pool, fashion podium, VR/AR content etc.

**Technical characteristics:**

* digital double 3d scan model
* decimated model (100k triangles)
* sufficiently clean
* PBR textures: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps
* non-overlapping UV map

You may find some of our 3d models in free access on SketchFab https://sketchfab.com/deep3dstudio/collections/sample-basic-3d-models

**New 3d models every day!**

results.name: Photoscanned Female Ankle Boots
results.description:
Photorealistic 3D model of a female boot. Low-Poly 3D Model was created in Maya by manual retopology of 3D model made using photogrammetry.
The model has no animations but can be easily imported and animated in 3dmodeling softwares or game engines.

Female Boots is a model game-ready and can be used easily with Unity3D or Unreal Engine for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games, renders or other real-time apps.

The model has different Texture Maps in order to produce better quality:

- Diffuse 1024x1024
- Normal 1024x1024
- Thickness 1024x1024
- Ambient Occlusion 1024x1024
